sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Physical Consignment of Shredded Non-Ferrous Scrap

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa currently maintains no comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double tax agreement in force for the reported jurisdiction; relevant trade framework includes the Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) and WTO membership.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1988 (No. 10 of 1988, as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2008; Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT directives; International Companies (Registered Agents) Regulations 2012.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national ID of each director, shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner, and controller
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national passport/identity authority or notary public in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing country is an Apostille Convention contracting state; otherwise consular legalization of the Samoa diplomatic mission with jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal record certificate for each ultimate beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police authority of each relevant country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter evidencing source of wealth and source of funds for each principal UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and source-of-wealth/sworn statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoa-licensed registered agent or notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in Samoa and, where the document proceeds abroad, consular legalization or Apostille as required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, corporate officers, and authorized signatories against the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit consolidated list, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) SDN List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and domestic Samoa discontinuance/designation lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for any person connected with a politically exposed person or a high-risk jurisdiction, with ongoing transaction monitoring commensurate with the AML/CFT statutory obligations and FATF Recommendations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry operated under the Samoan Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); name reservations are submitted by a licensed registered agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed names must be submitted in Roman/Latin script; English is the accepted official language for International Company filings. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Samoan company, reserved name, or registered foreign company. Any non-Roman script must be transliterated into a Latin-character form acceptable to the Registrar.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written notice of rejection, the applicant's registered agent may file an administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating concisely the grounds of non-prohibition, non-deception, and non-confusion. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 days of the appeal. If the appeal is refused, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days for judicial review of the Registrar's decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not accepted as a substitute for the statutory requirement that an International Company maintain a physical registered office located in Samoa. A licensed registered agent's physical address may serve as the registered office; an additional correspondence or service address may be virtual only if the statutory registered office remains physical and accessible for service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15-20% annual likelihood of regulatory premises verification for a medium-risk cross-border commodities trading vehicle; inspections are generally unannounced when triggered by AML/CFT intelligence, while routine license compliance visits may be scheduled with 48 hours' notice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name clearance and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of incorporation and first-year annual government fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual fee and incorporation fee under the International Companies Act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service for year one
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for corporate and custody services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO verification, PEP screening, and source of funds review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for enhanced due diligence package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille/consular legalization, and international courier of corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, consulate, and courier service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fees plus postage/courier service costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal opinion on corporate capacity, Samoan regulatory requirements, and sectoral compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for corporate transactional legal due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Recycled scrap copper wire trading statutory license / business license application fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour / Sectoral licensing authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory application fee for wholesale dealing in non-ferrous scrap materials

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss 4-6, 15-17 (Incorporation, Registered Office and Registered Agent), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019; read with Companies Act 2001 where expressly adopted.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: SIFSA – Registrar of International Companies, Level 3, Central Bank of Samoa Building, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an International Company (Form IC-01) and Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; a single subscriber share of US$1 is permissible. Share premiums and capital contributions must be credited through a licensed registered agent's escrow account prior to allotment, with the escrow deed maintained at the Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company subscribes for and issue 10,000 ordinary shares of US$0.01 each to the founding subscriber at par, credited as fully paid by the subscriber’s contribution into the company trust escrow account maintained by the registered agent. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and the registered agent is appointed as local agent for service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed as Director and [Name] as Secretary, each holding office until the next annual general meeting, and the Directors are authorised to open bank accounts, execute the Articles, and file the certificate of incorporation with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFSA Corporate Registry – Online Name Reservation Module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-0 electronically via the SIFSA e-Registry portal, pay the non-refundable search fee, and obtain the Name Reservation Letter prior to preparing incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of name search fee
Certificate of incorporation of any existing Samoa International Company with identical name (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused on grounds of conflict or prohibited expression, file a written objection with SIFSA within 5 business days and simultaneously submit three alternative names.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Submission of Incorporation Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFSA, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form IC-01 in full, attach the Memorandum and Articles of Association, execute before a Notary Public, and deliver either in hard copy to the SIFSA window or by upload to the SIFSA e-Registry. Pay the statutory filing fee using the prescribed wire or card channel.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in English (Chinese translation optional)
Declaration of consent from the licensed registered agent
Passport copies of subscriber, directors and proposed secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query letter, respond within 15 business days by amending the Articles or submitting supplementary declarations; after cure, the application is re-scheduled for approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry Review and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification of statutory compliance, the Registrar enters the Company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the official seal of Samoa. Obtain certified true copies for the bank and trading counterparties.
required_dossiers: Approved form IC-01 with the Registry receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a legal defect is discovered after issuance, file an application for rectification under s 17 of the International Companies Act 1987; a supplemental certificate may be issued without public notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Filings and Registered Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFSA Corporate Registry with the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the duly signed minutes of the first board meeting, register the appointed officers and the registered office address, issue share certificates to the subscriber, and file the Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent with the Registry.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual confirmation or officer change filing is rejected, correct the form and resubmit within 10 business days; late fees and a formal reply to the Registrar's notice will be processed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notification to Licensing Authorities on Commencement of Physical Consignment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, notify both authorities in writing of the intended commencement of cross-border consignment of recycled scrap copper wire, submit the Certificate of Incorporation, and request the applicable environmental and industrial licensing checklists.
required_dossiers: Notification letter describing the physical consignment model
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If either authority objects to the scope of notification, file an amended operational description and obtain a technical screening decision before proceeding with exports.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Trade and Industrial Licensing Division; for scrap metal exports, co-administered by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Scrap Metal Export Permit and Non-Ferrous Secondary Materials Trading Licence

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment and Conservation Division, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (Samoa)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B-2 – Full EIA Report required under Schedule 1.5 of the EIA Regulations 2017; activities involving storage and export of scrap metal with throughput of 2,500 tonnes or more per annum require a full Environmental Impact Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero discharge of process effluents to public wastewater; containment and treatment of stormwater per Best Practical Environmental Options; VOC emissions below 100 mg/Nm3 at stack; shredder dust and contaminated residues classified as hazardous waste under the Solid Waste Management Regulations 2017; waste export is subject to prior informed consent under the Basel Convention transposition in Samoa.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA), structural load inspection and certification by the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI), and occupational health and safety workplace clearance from MCIL Labour Division.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) – Ministry of Revenue, official portal www.sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident entities obtain a VAGST registration number by filing Form VAGST-REG with the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA). Mandatory registration applies when taxable supplies exceed WST 100,000 annually. A Samoa International Company (IC) receives its IC registration number from the Registrar of International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987, and is exempt from Samoa income tax. For VAGST purposes, the IC must separately register, appoint a fiscal representative, and submit audited financial statements and KYC documentation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Samoa. The International Company elects exempt offshore treatment under the International Companies Act 1987 (exemption from income tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty). No hybrid mismatch election regimes are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under Goods and Services Tax Act 2002 (amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time fiscal clearance. Tax invoices (paper or PDF) must contain seller and buyer VAGST ID numbers, description, value, and tax amount. VAGST returns are filed electronically through the SRA eTax portal. No digital stamping or continuous transaction control mechanism is applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Samoa to a non-resident recipient qualify for 0% VAGST. The goods must be physically exported within a documented period, and the seller must possess evidence of international transportation and foreign payment.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger retrospective clawback of the refunded VAGST amount plus a civil penalty of 50% of the tax sought, and interest at 1.5% per month. Criminal liability under the Tax Administration Act and Customs Act may include fines up to WST 20,000 and imprisonment for up to 2 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) acting as the exchange-control authority under the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Exchange Control Regulations 1981 and the Financial Institutions Act 1996; the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) licenses and supervises International Companies and any offshore banking license-holder. The Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and the Money Laundering Prevention Regulations 2009 complete the AML/CFT supervisory framework applicable to authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations (15 May 2006) and does not restrict payments and transfers for current international transactions. The WST is managed-float and deliverable, but the capital account is administered: non-resident capital injections, intercompany loans, share transfers and liquidation remittances require CBS approval through an authorized dealer, with documentary verification of commercial purpose. A WS_IC is exempt from the Exchange Control Act in respect of offshore foreign-currency business under the International Companies Act 1987, provided no transaction is conducted in WST or with a Samoan resident without CBS consent. Profit repatriation and dividend remittances are screened for substance, trade documentation and LME/CME copper-price benchmarking; practical hurdles include proof of physical scrap flows, invoice benchmarking, UBO disclosure thresholds and 3-10 business-day processing windows for CBS and AML verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exports of scrap copper wire from Samoa must be declared to Customs under the Customs Act 2014 and settled through an authorized dealer. The statutory rule requires export proceeds to be received within 6 months of the export date and, unless a foreign-currency account is approved by CBS, the exporter must offer the foreign currency to an authorized dealer for conversion into WST within one month of receipt; the mandatory conversion ratio for onshore settlement is 100% where the proceeds are not held in an approved foreign-currency account. For a WS_IC operating as a pure offshore consignment trader, the applicable effective ratio is 0% where all proceeds are held offshore or in a CBS-approved foreign-currency account and are applied to permissible offshore trade payments; any conversion to WST or onshore WST settlement triggers the 100% offer-to-sell obligation at the authorized dealer's buying rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Foreign-Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / FX Trade Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Samoa does not issue standalone EMI or payment-institution licenses; SIFA-licensed international banking is restricted to entities with physical presence and prudential capital in line with the Financial Institutions Act. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Currenxie, etc.) are not recognized as authorized dealers for CBS purposes and are generally unsuitable as the primary treasury corridor for a WS_IC trading physically-consigned recycled scrap; many EMIs auto-decline metal-scrap and high-risk recycled-commodity verticals. An EMI may be used after CBS no-objection only as a secondary channel for sub-threshold operational payables (below USD 10,000 per instruction) with full invoice-level supporting evidence retained.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoan banks mandate a physical or live video-verified interview for all directors, shareholders and UBOs of a WS_IC. ANZ and BSP require at least one director or authorized signatory to appear physically in Apia or at a recognized offshore representative office, unless the IC holds an introducer certificate from a SIFA-licensed trustee or licensed bank, in which case remote opening is conditionally permitted. In practice, a 100% physical-presence mandate applies where signatories are resident in high-risk jurisdictions; a registered-agent certificate of incumbency and certified passport copies are always required in addition to the standard KYC pack.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Metal-recyclables typology: high-value scrap copper wire shipments, invoice values diverging from LME/CME benchmarks, split invoicing or circular same-day fund movements between affiliated traders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-shipment trade dossier containing signed sale and purchase contracts, supplier invoice and packing list, container weight certificate, independent assay or sort analysis, customs export declarations, original bill of lading, matching LC or MT103 evidence, LME-CME benchmark reconciliation and a group funds-flow narrative for every treasury movement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: WS_IC held through a Samoan trust, foundation or nominee arrangement concealing the ultimate controller of the scrap trading operation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incumbency from the SIFA-licensed registered agent, certified trust deed or foundation charter, UBO declarations under the Companies Act 2001 and IC Act confidentiality rules, registered director and secretary consents, bank reference letters for each principal, and a Samoan legal opinion confirming the ownership chain and source of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory-license gap on the scrap-metal vertical; the business scope flag 'requires_statutory_license' triggers enhanced review of customs and environmental permits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Scrap-metal dealer license or export permit from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) or the Customs Authority, waste-environment compliance certificate, Basel Convention / OECD Green List classification for copper scrap, certificate of origin, board resolution approving the licensed activity and evidence that all permits are current.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and high-risk counterparty exposure: suppliers, smelters or shipping lines located in jurisdictions with weak trade or environmental controls, or dual-use metal routed near sanctioned ports.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-trade sanctions and PEP screening certificate for every counterparty, vessel and freight forwarder, compliance questionnaire for each supplier and buyer, shipping-line attestations on port calls, and a six-month bank-to-bank trading history showing settled LC or MT103 transactions with reputable clearing banks.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity and shareholder subordinated-debt injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the parent bank to the WS_IC's CBS-approved USD or AUD foreign-currency account, or to a capital-escrow account where escrow conditions are imposed. Routing protocol: (i) use the applicable CBS purpose code for equity injection or loan injection; (ii) attach board resolution, share-subscription or loan agreement, certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, UBO declaration and a source-of-funds letter tied to the recycled-copper trading cycle; (iii) never clear through the WST domestic clearing system; (iv) obtain CBS exchange-control approval before on-lending onshore; and (v) record the injection in the IC share register within 30 days to preserve the IC tax-exemption regime. All inward wires require UN and Samoan Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade sanctions screening and reconciliation to the IC's financial records.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for scrap-copper purchases and consignment fees clear via (i) SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfers below the documentary threshold, carrying full beneficiary details, invoice references and the applicable CBS purpose code for goods or trade services; (ii) irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP 600) issued by ANZ or BSP Samoa, with sight drafts against bill of lading, warehouse receipts, SGS inspection certificates and weight or assay certificates; and (iii) LC-at-sight (MT700) or MT103 TT-on-required-documents for Chinese and EU buyer receivables. USD and AUD payments achieve same-day value through New York and Australian correspondent corridors; WST clearing is disfavored for cross-border trade; CBS approval for genuine trade payments is automatic only where the supporting export documents are presented to the authorized dealer within the prescribed 6-month period.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable forward contracts (WST/USD, WST/AUD) up to 12 months tenor with ANZ or BSP Samoa under a local FX master agreement, requiring 25% initial-margin cover for ICs and documented underlying scrap-trade exposure.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for USD/WST and AUD/WST with offshore dealing counterparties where WST deliverability is impracticable; CBS prior approval is required per hedge series and the NDF must mature on the same value date as the underlying trade invoice.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/WST/AUD/EUR) for balance-sheet and working-capital hedging of genuine commercial exposures, subject to CBS approval, an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and approval by the Samoan bank's credit committee.

Zero-cost collars and participating forwards on USD/WST for shipment-based cash flows, available only where the IC demonstrates at least 12 months of historical and forecast scrap-export sales and an approved bank acts as counterparty.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee (International Company Annual Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation each year; standard fee band applies for authorized capital not exceeding USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee for each month or part-month overdue; SIFA may strike the company off the register if arrears remain unpaid for 6 months; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent (agent identity maintained on SIFA records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous obligation; renewed at each anniversary and upon any resignation or replacement of the agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A company without a licensed registered agent and physical registered office in Samoa loses good standing; SIFA may initiate administrative strike-off proceedings and dissolution after due notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and CDD Refresh Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (AML/CFT framework)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least annually at the anniversary date and promptly upon any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No SIFA filing fee; deficient CDD/UBO records expose the agent to AML penalties and impair the company's ability to complete share transfers, renew the annual license, and open or maintain documentary LC facilities with banks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued on demand, normally within 2-5 business days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Nil sanction; issuance is withheld until all annual license fees, penalties, and arrears are fully settled.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for Samoa International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987, irrespective of turnover, asset size, or share capital. No revenue or balance-sheet audit triggers apply. An independent audit may become contractually necessary under bank documentary LC facilities, supplier due diligence, or a shareholders' resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies are excluded from the Samoa Companies Act 2001 accounting, audit, and filing regime; voluntary financial statements are generally prepared under IFRS to satisfy banking and international trade counterparty requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa operates no public UBO register for International Companies. The SIFA-licensed registered agent must obtain and retain an updated beneficial ownership schedule and conduct a refreshed customer due diligence confirmation at least annually and at each share transfer. Share transfers must be registered in the Register of Members and the UBO schedule updated before the transfer is perfected; the recycled scrap copper wire trading entity remains fully non-resident and non-natural-person ownership is permissible.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (resolutions of members and directors)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $350 - $600 per annum (licensed agent fee inclusive of registered office services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,500 - $4,000 per annum where an IFRS audit is triggered by a bank LC facility or counterparty due diligence

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (general Samoa resident company rate under Income Tax Act 2012, as amended); effective rate 0% for a Samoa International Company (IC) because Section 202 of the International Companies Act 1987 grants a mandatory, absolute exemption from all Samoan taxes on income, profits, gains, capital, stamp duty, and withholding taxes.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory zero-rate exemption for International Companies: no income tax, no capital gains tax, no stamp duty, no dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, and no turnover or services tax on outbound transactions. Only fixed annual registry and license fees apply. The exemption is unconditional for a non-resident-owned IC that does not transact with Samoa residents and maintains its statutory agent and registered office in Samoa.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No formal CIT return (Form CIT-1) is filed by a tax-exempt IC. Compliance is executed through (1) the International Company Annual Return prescribed under the International Companies Act 1987 (Form MCIL-IC-AR) and (2) the Economic Substance Declaration (ESD) under the Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019, both submitted electronically via the Samoa Companies Registry e-Portal operated by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return and annual government fee are due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation. The Economic Substance Declaration for each financial period must be submitted within 12 months of the end of the IC's accounting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, registration number (format WS-IC-XXXX), incorporation date, and confirmation of entity type as 'International Company'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; any mismatch between the registry name and bank account/LC title documents will trigger enhanced AML review for scrap copper wire payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full street address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa; a post office box alone is not acceptable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders may not substitute an overseas business address; all statutory notices and tax audit correspondence are served at this Samoan address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, identity document numbers, residential addresses, and nationality of every director and company secretary; at least one natural-person director is mandatory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted, but nominee directors must be disclosed as nominees and the controlling principal identified in the accompanying beneficial ownership declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Share Capital and Beneficial Ownership Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized/issued share capital, share classes, and a schedule identifying every natural person holding directly or indirectly 10% or more of the issued shares or voting rights.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact ISIC 4669 description 'wholesale of waste and scrap - recycled shredded copper wire'. Attach the statutory scrap-metal trading/export license number and a short description of the physical flow (purchase from foreign upstream supplier, consignment, LC/TT settlement to non-resident sellers). This box determines the ESR classification as 'distribution and service centre'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Principal Business Activity and ISIC Code
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Primary business code and narrative trade description.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact ISIC 4669 description 'wholesale of waste and scrap - recycled shredded copper wire'. Attach the statutory scrap-metal trading/export license number and a short description of the physical flow (purchase from foreign upstream supplier, consignment, LC/TT settlement). This box determines the ESR category as 'distribution and service centre'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Tax Residence and Economic Substance Classification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC is tax resident in Samoa, tax resident in another jurisdiction, or is a non-resident tax-exempt entity; ESD requires a 'relevant activity' election where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select one: (i) foreign tax resident - attach foreign tax residence certificate (TRC); (ii) Samoa tax resident conducting distribution and service centre activity - provide substance particulars (Samoa premises, Samoan staff, board minutes held in Samoa); (iii) non-resident no-activity. A blank, contradictory, or 'shell' answer triggers an automatic ESR review and exchange of information.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Compliance Certificates and Prohibited Activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Executive certifications that the IC has not carried on business with Samoa residents, has not held or leased Samoan land except the registered office, has not undertaken banking/trust/insurance business, and that no beneficial owner is a Samoa tax resident.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign directors digitally sign under penalty of perjury. Any false statement voids the s.202 exemption and creates personal exposure for the signing director.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Return: WST 500 penalty for the first month and WST 200 per additional month, automatic strike-off after 90 days of default, and WST 1,000 restoration fee. Late or deficient ESD: fixed penalty up to WST 5,000 with continuing daily charges of WST 500. Willful false certification in any filing: corporate fine up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment of the authorizing officer for up to 3 years under the International Companies Act 1987. Registry penalties are imposed against the IC and are personally guaranteed by the registered agent in standard Samoa agency agreements.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders. The general Samoan non-resident dividend withholding tax rate is 15% under the Income Tax Act 2012, but it never applies to an IC in good standing because Section 202 of the International Companies Act 1987 exempts all distributions by ICs from any Samoan tax. Repatriation is therefore free of Samoa withholding tax, provided the IC has not breached its 'international' restrictions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No treaty application is required to secure the 0% domestic dividend exemption. Where the IC or its shareholder needs treaty protection in the counterparty payor state (e.g., New Zealand, Fiji, Norway, or China under Samoa's limited DTA network), the administrative protocol is: (1) obtain the MCIL Certificate of Compliance evidencing filed annual returns and paid registry fees; (2) obtain the Section 202 tax-exemption letter from the Registrar; (3) request a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the Samoa Revenue Authority - issued only if the IC demonstrates factual management and control in Samoa; (4) submit the TRC plus Form WHT-reduction claim to the foreign withholding agent before the payment date; TRCs in Samoan practice are issued for a 12-month forward period; reduced treaty rates generally range from 5% to 15% on dividends and 10% on interest. Because ICs are usually not Samoa tax residents, the foreign TRC route is unavailable and the practical document used is the exemption letter and Certificate of Compliance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoa withholding tax for non-residents: interest 15%, royalty 15%, management and technical service fees 15%, and non-resident contractor payments 15% under the Income Tax Act 2012. For an IC, the Section 202 exemption reduces the effective rate on outbound interest and royalties to 0%. Treaty rates on inbound Samoan payments (if an IC were ever to owe them): Samoa-New Zealand DTA - dividends 5%-15%, interest 10%, royalties 10%; Samoa-Fiji and Samoa-Norway DTAs generally cap interest and royalties at 10%-15%; the Samoa-China DTA provides 10% on interest and royalties, subject to full beneficial ownership assessment. For the scrap copper trade, interest on shareholder loans and trade finance from non-resident lenders is the most relevant outbound exposure and is exempt at 0% for an IC.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File/Master File, or CbC reporting threshold is imposed on a tax-exempt International Company under Samoa law. Samoa's Income Tax Act 2012 applies the arm's-length principle to associated persons but the IC's exemption removes it from the income tax net. Practical ESR substance benchmark applied by the Competent Authority for a distribution-and-service-centre IC trading recycled scrap copper: annual Samoan operating expenditure of at least WST 250,000 (approx. USD 90,000), a physical Samoan office, at least two full-time Samoan employees or an executed service agreement with the licensed registered agent, and board meetings physically held in Samoa at least twice per year. Related-party transaction evidence (independent pricing benchmark for the scrap purchase/resale margin) should be retained for 6 years even though no filing threshold exists.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019, together with the Economic Substance Regulations 2020, requires every International Company to file an annual Economic Substance Declaration (ESD). The wholesale-of-waste-and-scrap activity (ISIC 4669) is classified as a 'distribution and service centre' - a relevant activity. A Samoa tax-resident IC must demonstrate that core income-generating activities occur in Samoa: contracting and negotiation in Samoa, Samoan management decisions, Samoan bank accounts for settlement, and proportionally adequate Samoan staff and expenditure. An IC that proves tax residence in an approved foreign jurisdiction (by foreign TRC and management evidence) is displaced from the Samoa substance test, but non-resident ICs without foreign TRC must satisfy it in Samoa. Deficiencies are reported through the automatic exchange of information to the ultimate-parent jurisdiction, which exposes the IC to immediate audit in the shareholder's tax country. The doctrine effectively forbids zero-substance shell trading: a scrap copper trading IC must be either genuinely managed in Samoa, or genuinely resident and taxable in another jurisdiction - never stateless paper.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC is managed and controlled from Samoa, conducts ISIC 4669 distribution and service centre activity (cross-border consignment of recycled scrap copper), yet has no Samoan physical office, no Samoan employees, no Samoan bank account, and files an ESD falsely declaring 'no relevant activity' to avoid substance requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: First-year fixed penalty of up to WST 5,000 plus WST 500 per month of continuing non-compliance; escalation to a second-year penalty of up to WST 25,000; mandatory information exchange with the beneficial owner's tax authority; deregistration and strike-off of the IC; the Competent Authority may refer the file to the Samoa Revenue Authority for income tax assessment at 27% on the IC's global trading profits as though the exemption were void.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed registered agent are jointly and severally liable for unpaid ESD penalties; directors face disqualification for up to 5 years under the International Companies Act 1987; the Samoa court may issue a departure prohibition order preventing directors and the principal beneficial owner from leaving Samoa until all penalties are settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells shredded copper wire or provides procurement services to a Samoa-resident buyer - or collects domestic Samoan trade receivables - while continuing to claim the Section 202 exemption; invoices are routed through a connected offshore affiliate, and settlement is made into an unregistered Samoan bank account of the parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The exemption is voided retroactively to the date of the first prohibited transaction; the full 27% Samoan CIT is assessed on all Samoan-source trading profits; withholding tax at 15% is applied to every distribution made during the tainted period; late payment interest accrues at 2% per month, and a 50% shortfall penalty is added. The Minister of Customs and Revenue may also revoke the IC's registration certificates and freeze the Samoan settlement account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who signed false annual returns or who knowingly directed the tainted transactions face criminal fines up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment for up to 3 years; courts pierce the corporate veil to order civil restitution equal to the entire offshore profit trail, including fees paid to affiliates, and issue worldwide asset freezing orders against the directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in high-volume scrap copper wire trading while (i) accepting cash-equivalent or third-party payments instead of the declared Documentary LC / SWIFT TT rails; (ii) failing to conduct beneficial-owner due diligence on the industrial scrap supplier chain; (iii) shipping material sourced from sanctioned or conflict-affected territories; (iv) omitting suspicious transaction reports to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; or (v) operating without the statutory scrap-metal dealer and export license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fines up to WST 500,000 under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018; confiscation of the full cargo value and vessel/container seizure; per-transaction penalties for unlicensed scrap dealing; customs penalties up to three times the value of the misdescribed goods under the Customs Act 2014; referral to the Solicitor General for civil forfeiture proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors involved in the transactions face imprisonment up to 7 years; personal disgorgement of all fees and commissions earned in the tainted flow; travel bans and extradition exposure to the jurisdiction of the counterparty; the licensed registered agent may lose its license and be barred from acting as trustee or agent in Samoa.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Samoan IC purchases scrap copper from a related Cayman trader at USD 1,000 per metric ton and resells to a related Hong Kong buyer at USD 1,010 per metric ton, retaining a 1% markup with no independent benchmarking, no physical handling, no risk assumption, and no evidence that an independent metal wholesaler would accept such margin; the dominant purpose of the structure is to concentrate profit in a no-tax shell.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner may disregard the IC's exempt status or reallocate profits to the Samoa entity under the general anti-avoidance rule and transfer pricing provisions of the Income Tax Act 2012; re-adjusted profits are taxed at 27%; a 20% shortfall penalty applies plus daily late-interest; automatic exchange of information requires the reallocation to be notified to the parent and buyer jurisdictions, generating compensated assessments overseas.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved the pricing policy are jointly and severally liable for the adjusted tax shortfall and penalties; where the pricing memoranda are fabricated or backdated, criminal liability attaches for forgery and tax evasion with imprisonment up to 5 years; the court may bar the directors from holding office in any Samoan or foreign company registered in Samoa.
